title: Reels vs carousels: Nobody tells you Reels get the lowest reaction rate on Instagram
ig_caption:
Send this to whoever posts Reels daily and wonders why nobody reacts.

Instagram Reels vs carousels, from Buffer's numbers. Instagram engagement rate by format (median, as a share of reach):

- Carousels: 6.9%
- Single images: 4.4%
- Reels: 3.3%

Don't read that as Reels being bad. Buffer also found that Reels beat every other format on reach. Reels get you seen. Carousels get you a reaction. Different jobs, so post both.

Stories aren't in the numbers because the sample was small. Your account may behave differently, so check your own Insights before you change anything.

Source: Buffer, published March 2026.
